crossRefs.note: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the…
But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’
saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”
But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

translations.web: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
translations.bsb: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?”
translations.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
translations.asv: Which of these three, thinkest thou, proved neighbor unto him that fell among the robbers?
